positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed  backend software for Southwest Airlines to manage the operations of the aircrafts on ground.
- Software focused in CQRS pattern design using JE22, AKKA for error handling, JMS to communicate with external services and JAXB.
- Used Spring for dependency injection and REST Web Services.
- Applied test methodologies such as TDD with JUnit and BDD with Groovy
- Developed backend Big Data software for Gap in JE22 and Spring to do the packing and sizing of the products to be distributed around the world.
- Analyzed, defined and developed the mapping between the receipt entity and the mathematical model solver in charge of the packing optimization integrated with Apache Thrift objects.
